blocks.x: How Cyber & Zero-Trust lands in FinTech & Digital Natives — the constraints that shape the build, the gated delivery pattern, and the deltas we commit against your baseline.

FinTechs scale on decision speed: onboarding, fraud, credit and compliance must run real-time under regulatory scrutiny that grows with their size. The platforms that industrialize decisioning and evidence early avoid the mid-scale stall.

items: Evidence maturity lags size; audits painful.
Ring fraud and account abuse scale faster than rules.

blocks.x: The pattern composes Identity & Access Modernization, AI Security & Model Protection, Zero-Trust Architecture & Implementation from the Cybersecurity & Zero-Trust tower, wired into the unit's workflows (Onboarding/KYC, Fraud decisioning, Credit underwriting) on Dataq Sentinel and Dataq Compass. Governance inherits the sector frame — AML/CTF among others — with evidence generated by the delivery itself.

items: Assume breach, plan recovery: resilience engineered, rehearsed and measured.
Evidence once, audit anywhere: compliance automation across SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, DORA and privacy.
Never trust, always verify: zero-trust as an executable architecture, not a slide.

blocks.x: At industry level, the same pattern

At Technology & SaaS level this capability reads as: CRA-aligned secure development and vulnerability SLAs (enterprise security reviews passed faster). The sub-industry page narrows it to the unit's workflows, regimes and KPIs.

Every program of this type runs the same weekly rhythm, so your team can plan around it. Weeks 1–2 lock the baseline: the current metric is measured with your team and signed before build starts. Weeks 3–8 deliver the pilot on bounded scope — one decision path, one workflow, one plant or one portfolio — with a control owner named on your side. Weeks 9–12 industrialize what worked: runbooks, monitoring, enablement and a measured delta against the signed baseline. Anything that misses its gate is stopped or redirected with a documented decision, not quietly extended.
